architecture: Frozen DINOv2-S/14 plus the same 384-32-384 normalized residual MLP
aggregation: Differences are formed within the same category, seed and condition; categories and conditions are equally weighted within each seed. Report mean and sample SD across the three paired seed aggregates.
category_rule: Mean paired six-shift pixel AP over seeds: > +0.1 pp improved, < -0.1 pp degraded, inclusive interval [-0.1,+0.1] tied.
inference_limit: All categories were previously inspected. The original3/prior12 groups are not newly unseen validation sets. Seeds vary reference selection, initialization and center sampling on one shared test set; they are not independent datasets. Practical gates and positive means are not significance tests.
gate_interpretation: Apply the rule to all15 only, using unrounded paired values. A pass meets the predeclared practical criteria; it does not establish statistical significance, novelty, or a reason to overwrite frozen A1. All candidates, including failed gates, remain in the report.

training_manifest_checks.scope: Manifest-level final-step, parameter, paired split/initialization/schedule checks. The execution audit verifies raw checkpoint and metric identities.
